en.headline: St Joseph's Primary rebuild clears internal government checks
en.dek: Principal Lam Mei-kei told parents the Wan Chai school's long-planned in-situ project has passed internal approval and can now move toward detailed design, tendering and a funding bid to the Legislative Council.
body: St Joseph's Primary School in Wan Chai has told parents that its in-situ rebuild has passed the government's internal approval process, ending two years of delay before a funding request can go to the Legislative Council.

Principal Lam Mei-kei said in a letter that the school had received notice of the clearance. She described the step as a milestone but said work remains, including finalising the new building design, calling tenders and seeking LegCo funding. If those steps proceed as planned, construction could start by the end of next year.

The aided boys' school at 48 Wood Road has been preparing the project since 2023. Earlier plans had aimed for a 2025 start and a 2028 completion, but the school was told in two successive years that internal approval had not been granted, so the bid could not be submitted.

Published school plans describe a nine-storey building with seven floors above ground and two lower-ground levels, about 141,000 square feet of floor area, 30 classrooms and extra outdoor space including a rooftop football pitch. The works have been estimated at more than HK$400 million, with the government expected to fund the standard school premises and the school seeking about HK$50 million in donations for fittings above that standard. Pupils are expected to use a temporary campus during construction.

zh.headline: 聖若瑟小學原址重建通過內部審批
zh.dek: 校長林美琪向家長發信，指灣仔活道校舍重建已獲政府內部審批，下一步將定稿設計、招標及向立法會申請撥款，若順利可望明年底動工。
body: 灣仔聖若瑟小學向家長表示，籌備多年的原址重建已通過政府內部審批，結束連續兩年未能把撥款申請提交立法會的局面。
校長林美琪在家長信中證實校方已接獲通知，形容是項目里程碑，但後續工作仍然艱巨，包括敲定新校舍設計、招標及向立法會申請撥款。若程序順利，工程有望於明年底展開。
這所位於活道48號的津貼男校自2023年啟動重建計劃，原先期望2025年動工、2028年完工，但過去兩年都因未能通過內部審批，項目未能提交立法會。
校方早前公布的方案擬建地面七層連兩層地下低層、合共九層的新校舍，可建樓面約14.1萬平方呎，設30個課室及天台足球場等戶外空間。工程估計造價逾4億元，政府將資助標準校舍建設，校方另計劃籌款約5,000萬元添置高於標準的設施。施工期間學生料想暫遷其他校舍上課。
